description: SP Electricity North West, the distribution network operator for North West England, publishes 149 datasets on an Opendatasoft portal, read through its catalogue API on 2026-09-26. Network datasets include some 41,000 substations with unique six-digit numbers, infeed and outfeed voltages and upstream hierarchy, substation boundary polygons, and Voronoi supply polygons for distribution, primary, bulk supply and grid supply points. Capacity datasets give distribution transformer headroom on the 11 kV and 6.6 kV network, a primary heat map, and Network Development Plan demand and generation headroom forecasts by scenario and year. Distribution Future Electricity Scenarios data give primary substation forecasts of demand, heat pumps, electric vehicles, storage and generation, and low voltage datasets give peak demand and headroom from PreSENSE monitors, load-duration percentiles, smart meter penetration and MCS low carbon technology counts per substation. Datasets are classed open under CC BY 4.0 and free, but actual content requires a free portal account. Caveats: polygons are modelled supply areas and forecast positions are polygon centroids, not substation locations. Simulation uses are network flow and hosting capacity studies, capacity planning and resilience analysis of the North West distribution grid. Related records: data-uk-power-networks-open-data-portal and data-northern-powergrid-open-data-portal cover neighbouring areas.
